verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that Stripe Tax integrates with TaxJar to automate US sales tax filing, plus transaction-level tax reports and itemized exports. Nothing documents a filing calendar of upcoming returns, per-filing status, remitted amounts, or downloadable filing confirmations within Stripe Tax. A third-party filing integration and transaction reports are adjacent capabilities, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can see the whole filing picture — a calendar of upcoming returns, per-filing status, the amounts remitted, and downloadable confirmations for every return submitted
